title: fix(plugin-calendar): name the object by its label when a reschedule finds the record gone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWVeUdPTouw9owJWMAZ76p7)_

Fixes #31494

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 日历拖拽改期被服务端以 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 拒绝时,提示不再显示服务端原句(英文、带记录 id 和对象机器名),改为当前语言的一句话,用对象的显示名称指代对象;卡片照旧弹回原日期。
- **为什么改:** 中文会话下用户看到 `Record WB5z1sLAsWgE1tXL not found in showcase_task` 这样的英文系统句,违反「显示名称优先于机器名」规范(QA #31486)。
- **风险与回滚:** 只在 404/RECORD_NOT_FOUND 分支生效;作者标注的 userMessage、外部数据源只读、权限拒绝三条分支仍排在前面不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`(新分支与 `isRecordNotFound`)、`ObjectCalendar.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx`(新 describe)、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`(新键译文)。
- **两分钟验证:** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx`,预期 12 个用例全绿,其中 zh 用例读到「这条任务记录已不存在，或者您已无权访问它。」
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/plugin-calendar`:** `handleEventDropDefault`'s toast chain gains one branch after the permission branch and before `extractWriteErrorMessage`: a refusal whose code (on the error or its `details`) is `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, or whose status is 404, toasts `calendar.rescheduleNotFound` with the object named by its label. The label is the object schema's served `label` (already translated server-side), else the app's convention-key translation via `useSafeFieldLabel().objectLabel`, else no name at all: the toast then says the existing `form.recordNotFoundOrHidden` sentence. The server's sentence, the record id and the machine name never reach the toast. The rollback of the optimistic move is unchanged. The classifier is a small module-local `isRecordNotFound` built on `errorCodeIs` from `@object-ui/types`: `is404Error` lives in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, which this package has only as a devDependency, so reusing it would have meant a new runtime dependency edge.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** one new key, `calendar.rescheduleNotFound`, in all eleven `locales/*.ts` packs; zh-Hant generated from zh-Hans with `gen:zh-hant`. The sentence takes one placeholder, the object label.
- The shared `extractWriteErrorMessage` is not touched (no caller census needed).

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness `ObjectCalendar.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx` (wire-shaped errors through the real `normaliseClientError`, real MonthView drag):

- 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND with a served label: the toast is the labelled en sentence, contains no id, no machine name, no "not found in"; the event is back on its own day and absent from the target day.
- The same under a zh `I18nProvider` with the label 任务: the toast is the zh sentence.
- No label anywhere: the generic `form.recordNotFoundOrHidden` sentence, no machine name.
- A 404 that carries a `userMessage` still renders the marking.
- The external-source refusal (EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN) keeps its read-only sentence; an unmarked 403 keeps the permission substitution.

The test's drop-target lookup moved from the spoken cell label to the day number of the current-month cell, so the zh render finds it too; the previous `cellLabel` helper is removed.

## Acceptance notes

- The same raw-sentence shape likely exists on other write toasts that end in `extractWriteErrorMessage` (11 non-test files under `ui/packages` and `ui/apps` call it, `git grep` at d15c0ad4). Not changed here; the card scoped the fix to the calendar toast.

## Verification

- `vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.markedRefusalToast.test.tsx`: 12/12 passed.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/ packages/i18n/`: Test Files 167 passed, Tests 2312 passed, 108 skipped.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-calendar --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 53/53 tasks successful.
- `eslint` on the two calendar files: 0 errors (warnings all on untouched lines).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the `isRecordNotFound(err)` condition replaced by `false`): 3 failed, 9 passed; the three new not-found cases received `Record v1 not found in visit`; restore verified blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
